content: {"episode_id":"ep-05056","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry) was ordered for a patient with a history of recurrent syncope and palpitations, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other cardiac arrhythmias, supporting diagnosis codes I48.91, I49.9, and R55. The monitoring was indicated to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances and correlate symptoms with electrocardiographic findings over an extended monitoring period, which shorter-duration recording could not accomplish. The documented clinical indication establishes medical necessity for this service, and we request reconsideration of the CO-197 denial with retroactive authorization review."}
